description:
Local-first AI token usage & cost tracker for 29 AI coding tools — with native apps. Never reads prompts.

TokenTracker is an accurate, local-first token usage and cost dashboard for 29 AI coding tools including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, and Qoder. It automatically collects token usage and aggregates everything locally, with a desktop pet, 4 native widgets, and 15 achievement tracks. No cloud account, no API keys, no setup. The Windows app runs as a system-tray companion that never reads your prompts.
What's Changed
- fix(pricing): add GPT-6.1 Terra official Standard USD rates by @xiufengsun in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/890
- fix(dashboard): keep session efficiency columns reachable by @shixiaogaoya in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/887
- fix(usage): keep ultrafast subsets in session filter and device transfer (#886) by @xiufengsun in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/891
- fix(qoder): restore Qoder / Qoder CN tracking after usage-shape drift (v1.4.13) by @Acfufu in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/889
New Contributors
- @Acfufu made their first contribution in https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/pull/889
Full Changelog: https://github.com/xiufengsun/TokenTracker/compare/v1.4.12...v1.4.13
